items.text: Bears planning to start QB Caleb Williams vs Falcons after full week of practice with no setbacks from torn hamstring; listed Q but took starter reps.
items.why: Full practice week, starter reps, sources confirm plan to start.
items.implication: Bears offense unlocks; boost to Odunze, Moore, Loveland etc.
items.opportunity: Full snap share and passing volume returns for CHI skill players.

items.text: Eagles officially placed QB Jalen Hurts on injured reserve due to a blood clot in his calf after consultations with doctors; out for the foreseeable future. Tanner McKee will start.
items.why: Blood clot confirmed via ultrasound and expert consults; IR move official Saturday.
items.implication: McKee starts; PHI offense limited, especially without Barkley; pass-catchers still viable but lower ceiling.
items.opportunity: Elevated role for Dameon Pierce at RB; healthy top pass-catchers (Smith, Goedert, Wicks) get volume under McKee.

items.text: Patriots officially activated WR A.J. Brown from IR to 53-man roster; expected to play Sunday vs Jets after high-ankle sprain.
items.why: Activated Saturday after limited practice all week; Schefter/Rapoport expect play.
items.implication: Major upgrade for Drake Maye and NE passing attack; start as WR2 if active.
items.opportunity: Targets/routes return for Brown; potential slight dilution for other NE WRs but overall offense boost.

items.text: Saquon Barkley ruled OUT for Week 6; Will Shipley also OUT/IR. Dameon Pierce expected to handle lead back duties with McKee at QB.
items.why: Hamstring; confirmed OUT on ETR list and Schefter report.
items.implication: PHI RB room thin; Pierce gets work but limited upside in backup QB game.
items.opportunity: Carries and any receiving work to Dameon Pierce (4th-string previously).

items.text: Pick up Tanner McKee in any league needing QB; will be better than thought. Not worried about Eagles skill players with him; start AJ Brown if active as WR2.
items.why: McKee can play; skill players healthy; AJB expected active.
items.implication: McKee streaming option; AJB immediate start.
items.opportunity: PHI pass-catcher volume stable; AJB targets return.

items.text: DK Metcalf (illness) removed from Steelers injury report; no designation for Sunday vs TB. PIT thin at other WRs.
items.implication: Full go; heavy usage expected in 2-WR sets.
items.opportunity: Elevated target share with Pittman/Wilson/Skowronek out.

items.text: Unclear on Qs AJ Brown (ankle), TreVeyon Henderson (ankle), DJ Moore (shoulder). Tyler Warren Friday Q add (groin). Probable-leaning: Caleb, Metcalf, Olave, Dowdle. PIT thin at WR (Metcalf + Bernard heavy 2-WR). PHI McKee + healthy top-4 pass catchers but 4th-string RB.
items.why: Practice/report context and team WR depth notes; Henderson high-ankle doubt low given practice.
items.implication: Monitor Brown/Henderson closely; Metcalf elevated in thin PIT group; PHI pass game safer than RB.
items.opportunity: Metcalf route/target share spike; Warren/others if cleared; PHI WRs/TE volume under McKee.

items.text: Lamar Jackson OUT for Week 6 vs Browns (ankle); Tyler Huntley starts again. Ja'Kobi Lane activated and expected to play.
items.why: Ankle; ruled out Friday, confirmed on lists.
items.implication: BAL passing game downgraded; Flowers still startable, Andrews lower.
items.opportunity: Lane returns for targets; Huntley limits overall ceiling.

items.text: Key OUTs: Rashee Rice, Breece Hall, David Montgomery, Jeremiyah Love, Baker Mayfield. INs: Ladd McConkey, DeVonta Smith, CeeDee Lamb, Ashton Jeanty, Michael Penix.
items.why: Comprehensive Friday ETR injury roundup for Sunday games.
items.implication: Handcuffs and backups elevated; clear starters return for volume.
items.opportunity: Role expansion for KC/NYJ/HOU/ARI backups; full roles for listed INs.

items.text: Ravens officially activated WR Ja’Kobi Lane from IR; expected to play Sunday vs Browns.
items.why: Activated; expected play with Lamar out.
items.implication: Depth/target option in BAL offense under Huntley.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets available in depleted pass game.

items.text: Loves Mike Evans (vs WSH WR4), Drake London (vs CHI WR6), George Kittle (vs WSH TE3) due to Washington defense buffet for pass catchers and strong usage/roles.
items.why: WSH defense nightmare vs WR/TE; London/Golden bankable usage.
items.opportunity: High target/red-zone potential vs weak secondary.

items.text: Loves Kyren Williams (vs ARI RB5), Javonte Williams (@GB RB8), Rhamondre Stevenson (vs NYJ RB9) for volume and leaky run defenses; Kyren elite usage, Javonte goal-line role.
items.why: Volume + matchups vs run-leaking defenses; goal-line work for Javonte.

items.text: Hates Jaylen Waddle (vs SEA WR28), Emeka Egbuka (vs PIT WR34), Kyle Pitts (vs CHI TE18) due to tough matchups and shaky QB/feeding issues.
items.why: Ugly matchups + limited recent targets/QB situations.
items.implication: Fade or sit in most formats.

items.text: Hates J.K. Dobbins (vs SEA), Bo Nix (vs SEA), Justin Herbert (@KC) for tough run/pass defenses and low team totals/scoring ruts.
items.why: Elite defenses shutting down and low implied totals.
